justification.dataset: DANDI:000053 is a spatial-navigation recording with position and LFP, but units were never verified as hippocampal or as place cells and it is not a canonical theta-precession dataset, so the demonstration was made harder than needed.
justification.handling: Real data was streamed from S3 and loaded correctly, but units were unfiltered (first 35, no region or quality criteria) and behavioral speed contained impossible values (-6191 cm/s) left uncleaned.
justification.analysis: The precession analysis regresses unwrapped LFP phase against absolute position rather than spike phase against within-field position, so it does not test precession, and entrainment has no Rayleigh or shuffle significance test.
justification.correctness: The precession regression line in the figure is detached from the plotted data (line at ~6400 rad, points at ~0), making the headline 0.4587 rad/cm an unwrapping artifact and internally contradictory.
justification.figures: The figures contradict the text: the spike-phase histogram is flat (no entrainment) and the precession fit line does not touch its data, so they do not show the claimed effects.
justification.honesty: A null entrainment (r=0.055, uniform histogram) and a broken precession fit are both presented as clean positive findings with no caveat and units mislabeled as place cells, triggering multiple axis-6 disqualifying acts.
justification.verdict: The core analysis is invalid and the write-up asserts positive results its own figures refute, so the run must be rejected.
